description: This file defines a struct called DeviceInfos that contains information about physical devices such as displays or printers, including size, resolution, DPI, and scale factors. It provides a method to retrieve device info from a device context handle.

classes.name: DeviceInfos
classes.description: Contains device metrics and a static method to retrieve device information for a given device context handle.

methods.name: GetInfos
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as size, resolution, DPI, and scale factors from a device context handle.
